description: Synthetic-only free-axis versus ideal prescribed-path comparison. Both models share the same deterministic PD current command callback and constant five-axis external generalized-force callback. Every model, load, state, controller, normalization scale and path value is an analyst-authored fixture, not CNC machine data.

provenance.parameter_source: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE: PATH-01 borrows the synthetic electromechanical/structural/dissipation fixture from ENE-03, and adds an explicitly synthetic rest-to-rest path and common deterministic PD current callback. SRC-000369/SRC-000370 identify generic feed-drive modelling context; SRC-000372 supports RK4; SRC-000373 supports the generic quintic rest-to-rest time-scaling law. None of these sources supplies the numeric fixture values or application acceptance limits.

mechanical.note: All nonzero D0 diagonal coefficients, viscous friction, Coulomb friction, and smoothing speed are synthetic fixture values. D0 is diagonal positive definite in this fixture; no coefficient is sourced from a machine.

electrical.note: Every value is a synthetic fixture. Ke and Kf remain equal in SI units to retain reciprocal electromechanical power transfer; they are not catalogue values or a motor selection.

actuator.displacement_definition_and_sign: Synthetic actuator displacement ell_a = 0.1*q1 + s, with positive ell_a defined by positive s and positive q1 contributions; all coefficients are fixture values.

prescribed_path.out_of_range_policy: Reject or explicitly define extension; do not silently extrapolate.
prescribed_path.note: The rest-to-rest path and endpoints are synthetic comparison fixtures, not an application command or measured machine trajectory.

controller_and_loads.i_ff_definition_or_artifact: Constant synthetic feedforward current i_ff=0.5 A shared by both models.
controller_and_loads.external_force_definition_or_artifact: Constant synthetic generalized force copied from the ENE-03 fixture and shared by both models; no cutting/contact force identification is implied.
controller_and_loads.note: Both models call the same deterministic position/velocity PD current law and use the same external-force vector. Actuator force is generated by the electromechanical port and is not double-counted as external load.

metrics.comparison_scale_source: The per-component absolute values in tolerances are dimensional normalization anchors for comparing free and prescribed state trajectories. They are not acceptance tolerances, accuracy requirements or application limits; all relative comparison scales are zero for this synthetic fixture.
metrics.note: No application acceptance limits are supplied. The runner must therefore return COMPLETED_REPORT_ONLY even when both numerical convergence screens pass.

acceptance.note: All application limits deliberately remain null. Results are descriptive synthetic free-versus-ideal-constraint comparisons only; null limits prohibit engineering PASS/FAIL.
